newsitem.title: USA: Above normal temps expected in western US - NWS.
newsitem.headline: Above normal temps expected in western US - NWS.

text.p: The National Weather Service on Thursday said it expects above-normal temperatures in the western half of the United States in April.

The above-normal temperatures are expected for the western part of the nation, excluding the central Rockies and the central High Plains from Utah in the West to South Dakota and Oklahoma in the East, the NWS said in its monthly report.
Normal temperatures were expected for the rest of the country.
The NWS said it could not predict precipitation for April.
The next 30-day outlook will be issued on Thursday, April 17.
